customManagers.description: Track the pinned zizmor CLI version in the Claude PostToolUse hook as zizmorcore/zizmor, so it lands in the Zizmor group and moves in lockstep with the zizmor.yml `version:` pin and the zizmor-action release. This repo's hook lives at .claude/hooks/zizmor-check.sh; the org :gha preset covers the same path, but this repo's zizmor.yml pin uses the `# renovate:` annotation rather than the `# pin the CLI` comment, so the hook manager is kept inline alongside it for clarity.

Track the actionlint-py pin (PyPI wheel bundling the actionlint CLI; version is <actionlint>.<build>, so the org `# renovate:` annotation manager's 3-part version regex cannot claim it) in the actionlint.yml workflow env and the Claude PostToolUse hook. The pre-commit `rev:` itself is tracked by the built-in pre-commit manager; the actionlint packageRule below groups them so every layer lints with the same CLI.

Track the shellcheck-py pin actionlint uses for `run:` blocks, in the actionlint.yml workflow env and as the pre-commit actionlint hook's additional dependency. A separate manager from actionlint-py: a depNameTemplate overrides a captured depName group, so one manager cannot serve two packages. The built-in pre-commit manager only parses additional_dependencies when the hook declares `language:` explicitly; keep that key off the actionlint hook or both managers claim the line.

packageRules.description: actionlint toolchain - one branch for the pre-commit rev (github-tags), the actionlint-py pin in the workflow and Claude hook, and the shellcheck-py pin in the workflow and pre-commit config, so CI, pre-commit and the agent never lint with different versions.

The pre-commit rev is a four-part tag (v<actionlint>.<build>). The default semver-coerced versioning drops the fourth component, so build-only bumps are never offered and same-CLI tags compare equal; loose orders all four numerically so the rev keeps pace with the PyPI pins.
Branch automerge for non-majors: merge the green branch without opening a PR at all - the cheapest possible path for this repo's lightweight CI.
Actions bumped here are our own product surface; suffix the commit so consuming repos can spot the source.
Scope ecs-query dependency updates to ecs-deploy component

conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits v10 requires conventional-changelog-writer@9, but @semantic-release/release-notes-generator 14.x (what semantic-release 25 depends on) bundles writer 8, so generateNotes throws 'Missing helper' and every component release fails (broke docker-build-ghcr-v1.0.0 after #21). Hold the preset below 10 until release-notes-generator 15 ships and semantic-release depends on it, then drop this rule.

Trivy - group the CLI version pin (tofu-pre-commit.yml setup-trivy version: input) with the setup-trivy action, gated behind Dependency Dashboard approval and never automerged; a security scanner bump should be vetted before the gate moves. Also stops the phantom pin error: the built-in github-actions manager maps setup-trivy's version: input to a virtual aquasecurity/trivy dep with no digest-pinnable literal in the file, so pinDigests fails it ('Error updating branch: update failure' on renovate/pin-dependencies). Grouping under dashboard approval keeps that pin out of the auto-attempted path. Mirrors isw-kudos/irt-flight-manager.

Disable digest pinning for the two VIRTUAL deps the github-actions manager derives from setup-trivy / zizmor-action `version:` inputs. These are CLI version strings, not uses:/image: refs, so there is no digest-pinnable literal in the workflow - pinDigests just fails the renovate/pin-dependencies branch ('Error updating branch: update failure'). The real SHA-pinned action refs (aquasecurity/setup-trivy, zizmorcore/zizmor-action) are separate uses: lines, unaffected by this and still pinned. Must stay AFTER the preset rule that sets pinDigests:true for github-actions so this override wins.
